clue.text: Added words about success, so one gathers

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other, here the postscript around success

parts.note: PS, postscript, is words added at the end of a letter
luck is good fortune or success

explanation.surface: Someone tacks a postscript praising success onto a letter, and one gathers its meaning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the container. 'so one' is linking: 'one plucks' reads as 'one gathers'.
explanation.definitionFit: To pluck flowers or fruit is to pick and collect them.

clue.text: Stay faithful

definitions.meaning: to stay is to stop or check

explanation.surface: An order to remain loyal.
explanation.definitionFit: Staunch as a verb means to stem a flow, a kind of halting; as an adjective it means steadfastly loyal.

clue.text: The claimant's quiet about a certain offer made

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
re is Latin-derived for about or concerning
a tender is a formal offer, as for a contract

explanation.surface: A claimant keeps silent about some offer that has been made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a certain' and 'made' only pad the surface; the 's of 'claimant's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A pretender is someone laying claim to a title or throne, such as the Old Pretender.

clue.text: Band having an outing in the Dover area

indicators.note: in places the outing inside the letters for the south-east region

parts.note: Dover is in the south-east of England, abbreviated SE
a trip is an outing or excursion

explanation.surface: A music band goes on an outing around the Kent coast near Dover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Band' looks like a group of musicians; it is a strip of colour. Dover is a port in the south-east of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A stripe is a narrow band of colour or material.

clue.text: Recommendation of American lawyer backed by deputy

indicators.note: backed means the lawyer's letters are turned to run backwards

parts.note: DA, district attorney, is an American prosecuting lawyer
vice, as in vice-president, means a deputy

explanation.surface: A US attorney's recommendation is endorsed by an assistant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' turns DA into AD.
explanation.definitionFit: Advice is guidance or a suggestion on what to do.

clue.text: Working out latitude and height

indicators.note: working out suggests the letters of the word are processed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A navigator works out latitude and height above sea level.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Working out' looks like calculating; it is the anagram signal on LATITUDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Altitude is elevation above sea level, i.e. how high something is.

clue.text: Few like imbibing fifty bottles!

parts.note: VI, the Roman numeral six, stands for a few

indicators.note: imbibing means taking in, so the word for like swallows the numeral

parts.note: as means like, in comparisons
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Few people enjoy drinking down fifty bottles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'imbibing' signals the container; calling six 'few' is a loose crossword liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: Vials are small glass containers for liquids or medicine.

clue.text: Poles and Oriental taken in by free detergent

indicators.note: taken in by means these letters go inside the word for free

parts.note: clear means free, as in clear of obstruction
N and S are the north and south poles
E, east, stands for Oriental

explanation.surface: Polish and Asian workers are given free detergent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in by' places NSE inside CLEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleanser is a cleaning agent, like a detergent.

clue.text: The French assume it to blame, it's learned

indicators.note: assume means take on, so the French article takes these letters inside it

parts.note: le is French for the
to rate is to scold or berate someone

explanation.surface: The French assume someone is at fault, though that person is educated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assume' signals the container; 'rate' in the old sense of scold is less common than its numerical sense. "it's" is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Literate means well-read and educated, as a learned person is.

clue.text: A virtuous man, ready for a change, transgressed

parts.note: ST, saint, is a virtuous man

indicators.note: for a change says the letters of ready are rearranged

explanation.surface: A good man, ready for something different, went astray.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a change' scrambles the five letters of 'ready'; the surface's change of heart is a pretence.
explanation.definitionFit: To stray is to wander from the right path, i.e. to sin.

clue.text: Sum up foreign aristocracy

definitions.meaning: a European nobleman, a title used abroad equal to an earl

explanation.surface: Totting up the wealth of a foreign nobility.
explanation.definitionFit: To count is to add numbers; a count is a continental noble ranking with a British earl.

clue.text: Champions of pithead workers

parts.note: read as pit-head, the head or first letter of the word pit
artisans are skilled manual workers

explanation.surface: Supporters of miners at the colliery entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pithead' looks like the top of a mine shaft; it gives the head of 'pit'.
explanation.definitionFit: Partisans are committed supporters of a cause.

clue.text: Live as part of a religious community

indicators.note: part of says the answer lies within the words a religious

explanation.surface: Living within a religious community.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Live' is a verb here: we live, we are.
explanation.definitionFit: To be, i.e. exist, is to live; are is a form of be.

clue.text: A supporter revealing hesitation after a very short time

indicators.note: after means the hesitation comes after the short time

parts.note: a second is a very short time
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A supporter shows hesitation after a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' places the hesitation at the end; 'revealing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A seconder backs a motion at a meeting.

clue.text: A designer with magnetic personality?

definitions.meaning: one who draws pictures or plans
one who draws in crowds, attracting them

explanation.surface: A designer with charisma.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawer sketches designs, and is also one who draws, attracting people.

clue.text: One credit organisation that's not at all well known

indicators.note: organisation means the letters are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A single credit body that nobody has heard of.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' looks like a company; it signals rearranging ONE CREDIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Recondite means obscure, little known.

clue.text: "Men only of creatures rational." Milton (Paradise Lost)

definitions.text: "Men only of creatures rational." Milton (Paradise Lost)

parts.words: "Men only of creatures rational." Milton (Paradise Lost)
parts.note: a quotation with a gap: in Paradise Lost, Book II, devils hold firm concord, while men alone of rational creatures fall out with each other

explanation.surface: A line from Milton's Paradise Lost about mankind.
explanation.walkthrough: The missing word follows 'only' in Milton's line about devils being in concord while men quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: The quoted line says men quarrel; to be at odds is the missing verb.

clue.text: Not all people feel kindly towards deer

indicators.note: not all says only part of the words feel kindly is used

explanation.surface: Not everyone feels warmly towards deer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not all' picks letters running across 'feel kindly'; 'towards' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The elk is a large species of deer.

clue.text: They sounded deep

parts.note: sounded means measured the depth of water with a weighted line, not spoke in low voices

explanation.surface: People who spoke in low voices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sounded deep' suggests deep voices; it means took soundings of water depth.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors who cast the lead line to measure water depth.

clue.text: View quarters, given a key

parts.note: S and E are two compass quarters, south and east
E is a musical key

explanation.surface: Inspecting rooms after being given a key.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quarters' looks like lodgings; it means compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: To see is to look at or view.

clue.text: Burning to include bill for carriage

indicators.note: to include means the burning word takes the bill inside

parts.note: fire is burning
AC, account, is a bill

explanation.surface: A blaze swallows up a bill for transport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to include' signals the container; a fiacre is named after the Hotel Saint-Fiacre in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiacre is a small French horse-drawn hackney carriage.

clue.text: Didn't stand for article being in the way

indicators.note: being in means the article goes inside the abbreviation for the way

parts.note: ST, street, is a way
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone stayed seated because an object was blocking the path.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being in' puts A inside ST; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: If one sat, one was seated rather than upright.

clue.text: Could be a German administrator

indicators.note: could be says the letters may become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: The administrator might be a German.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Could be' signals rearranging A GERMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A manager runs or administers a business.

clue.text: Jason wants a rug, not a rum!

indicators.note: rum means odd or strange, so the letters are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: Jason wants a rug rather than a glass of rum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' looks like the drink; it means odd, the anagram signal on A RUG NOT A. 'wants' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Jason led the crew of the Argo, the sailors in search of the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Staggered to find a slippery customer in the red

indicators.note: in places the slippery customer inside the colour

parts.note: red is the colour itself
an eel is notoriously slippery

explanation.surface: Someone was shocked to find a con man running up debts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a slippery customer' sounds like a crook; it is a fish. 'in the red' looks like debt.
explanation.definitionFit: To reel is to stagger unsteadily.

clue.text: Lunch in an attempt to get agreement

indicators.note: in means the lunch word goes inside the attempt word

parts.note: a try is an attempt
to lunch is to eat

explanation.surface: A business lunch is an attempt to secure a deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lunch' is a verb: to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty is a formal agreement between states.

clue.text: Blunt note about a competitor

indicators.note: about means the frank word and the note go around the letter a

parts.note: candid means frank, blunt
te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A frank message about a contender.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' means the frank word plus the note wrap around the A, which ends up between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A candidate competes for a post or prize.

clue.text: Many an engineer has to hop about

parts.note: D, 500 in Roman numerals, stands for many
CE, civil engineer

explanation.surface: Lots of engineers must jump around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A hop is an informal dance, and to dance is to jump about.

clue.text: Doctor copy to provide cover-up

parts.note: to ape is to copy

explanation.surface: A physician falsifies a document to conceal something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a verb meaning falsify; it is DR.
explanation.definitionFit: A drape is a cloth hung to cover something.

clue.text: The older woman makes an excellent scholar

parts.note: grand means excellent
MA, Master of Arts, a scholar

explanation.surface: The elderly lady proves a brilliant scholar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'makes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A grandmother is an older female relative, one generation above a parent.

clue.text: Aware ten-ten is unsatisfactory result

indicators.note: an unsatisfactory result suggests the letters ended up in a muddled order

explanation.surface: Someone knows a ten-all draw is a poor outcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsatisfactory result' looks like a score comment; it rearranges TENTEN and IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Sentient means able to perceive and feel, conscious.

clue.text: A girl will take an age getting on this

parts.note: her refers to a girl
an eon is an age

explanation.surface: A girl will take ages to get on this.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will take' and 'getting' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Hereon is a formal word for upon or following this point.
